title: Read data-only scene layout geometry (narrator / caption / Remotion boxes)
description:
Synchronous, free, read-only. Use AFTER /v1/video_data and BEFORE
/v1/modify_scene or /v1/scene_inspector. Resolves one scene by
stable voice_file (preferred), loads {voice_file}_spec.json if
available, and returns narrator/caption/Remotion Storyboard display
boxes in one 280×498 editor-preview coordinate space — plus dead
zones, collision violations, and warnings. Designed for LLM-only
agents that cannot see images: reason over JSON, then call
/v1/modify_scene with a layout.batch (or single-field) edit. Never
broadcasts MQTT, never renders screenshots, never modifies the video.

fields.name: by
fields.label: by (only if voice_file / scene_id not set)

use_cases.title: 🧭 Audit a scene by voice_file (preferred)
use_cases.description: Cheapest, most reliable selector — paste the scene's voice_file from /v1/video_data.

use_cases.title: 📝 Audit a scene by fuzzy narration text
use_cases.description: Use when the user names a scene by what's said. Multi-match returns a ClarificationResponse — pick a voice_file and retry.
